title: Facebook confirmed Mark Zuckerberg's beef with Apple CEO Tim Cook in an official company statement (AAPL, FB)
text:
Tim Cook Mark Zuckerberg
Thursday, 15 November 2018 ( 30 minutes ago )
· Apple CEO Tim Cook and Facebook CEO Mark Zuckerberg have traded insults and barbs over the years.
· The latest example is that Zuckerberg even asked his employees to use Android phones and not Apple phones after Cook criticized Facebook in a televised interview.
